correctness.rationale: Exact finite proof: every multipath arc face is independently recognized by degree constraints and directed-acyclicity; 715 augmented faces, 2394 Hasse incidences. Deterministic 341-pair nonaugmented acyclic matching leaves one zero-cell, nineteen three-cells, twelve four-cells. Every signed integral unit-pivot cancellation succeeds; the sole residual augmented boundary is the zero-cell augmentation, so the 4-to-3 Morse differential vanishes integrally. Because pi_3 of the resulting wedge of nineteen S^3 is Z^19 and Hurewicz is an isomorphism, attaching maps of four-cells are null; the wedge homotopy conclusion follows. Independent F2 elimination gives ranks (1,17,91,173,60) and Betti (0,0,0,19,12). Certificate is included and replayable.

value.rationale: The fully bidirected K3,3 is the smallest balanced complete bipartite example with three sources and three sinks in each part and both arc orientations, where simultaneous in/out constraints and directed 4-cycles interact. Determining its mixed homotopy wedge in degrees three and four is materially stronger than prior one-way matching Euler formulas. The comparison with the alternating orientation, whose matching complex is a four-circle wedge, identifies a genuine topology transition caused by allowing reverse arcs. This concrete natural test case is useful for theories of path-poset and directed-linear-forest complexes; no generalization is claimed.
